input_domain_boundaries.reason: Pinned upstream wide_path helper adds one to failed mbstowcs length and subsequently reads uninitialized allocation; malformed UTF-8 has no stable upstream result. capability_boundaries.reason: CP29001 conversion failure is measured directly through the Windows API. Upstream cygpath ignores the zero WideCharToMultiByte return and reads its uninitialized output allocation. Retain actual raw bytes without declaring them a valid encoding; require deterministic project rejection.
